description: How MCP stands on this host's tailnet name, as Tailscale says now: it only reads. In this session a stand-in for `tailscale` answers, as for a Linux host; a real Mac doesn't serve this way, and says so in `note`, with `available` false. Here `/mcp` on Serve is this host's, but `mcp_tailscale` is off, so it can't answer.

result.note: Tailscale serves /mcp for this host, but mcp_tailscale is off, so it can't answer. Turn this on to finish, or remove it with `tailscale serve --https=443 --set-path=/mcp off`.
